shell — container-only by construction. keen's table/1 is normally DATA-DRIVEN (`:col` slots generate thead/tbody), but renders the SAME container-only shape when given NO `:col` slots (a bare around inner_block, the consumer-authored-rows shape) — this fixture exercises that path, so both wrappers align on the one pa-table class contract.

propsVocabulary.body: the row area — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (real <thead>/<tbody> children are native elements written inside the slot by the consumer, not a sub-component). svelte: children (Snippet); keen: inner_block slot (the no-:col container path)
propsVocabulary.striped: pa-table--striped — zebra-stripe even body rows. svelte isStriped; keen is_striped
propsVocabulary.bordered: pa-table--bordered — full cell borders on all sides. svelte isBordered; keen is_bordered
propsVocabulary.plain: pa-table--plain — neutral ruled grid: strips the themed header fill + body/stripe backgrounds so the table inherits its surface (paper forms, printouts, sheet grids). Pair with bordered for cell rules. svelte isPlain; keen is_plain
propsVocabulary.responsive: pa-table--responsive — mobile row→card transform (thead hidden, each row a card via data-label). svelte isResponsive; keen is_responsive
propsVocabulary.responsiveGrid: pa-table--responsive-grid — mobile CSS-Grid collapse (per-tr data-grid). svelte isResponsiveGrid; keen is_responsive_grid
propsVocabulary.size: pa-table--{xs|sm|lg|xl} — cell-padding/height size, synced with button/input sizes. svelte size (enum); keen size (enum). svelte's isCompact / keen's is_compact are sugar for size=xs (same pa-table--xs class) — not a separate feature.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural only — the table container adds no attribute conventions. The body slot is a plain text token (Body), so the diff checks the container's tag (<table>) + class + the pa-table--* modifiers, not rich thead/tbody content. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. axis-1 reverse-check is scoped to the pa-table--* BLOCK modifiers. Real authored modifiers: --striped, --bordered, --plain, --responsive, --responsive-grid, and the four size steps --xs/--sm/--lg/--xl (one `size` enum). The compound selector `pa-table--bordered--responsive` that the extractor also sees is NOT a real modifier — it's an SCSS artifact of `.pa-table--bordered &:not(&--responsive)` nesting (& = .pa-table--bordered), accounted for in cssStateClasses. The pa-table__* element classes (item-title/item-desc two-line cell; checkbox-col/row--selected selectable rows) are native cell content / data-driven sub-features, DEFERRED (prose) — not container markup. body + extraClass are structural/passthrough.

size.note: cell size; svelte/keen size enum. isCompact/is_compact are sugar for xs (same class).

body.note: structural — the container's inner content; thead/tbody are native elements written inside the slot by the consumer

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: NOT a runtime-toggled state class — the one entry here is an SCSS-nesting artifact. `pa-table--bordered--responsive` is emitted by `.pa-table--bordered { &:not(&--responsive) { … } }` where `&` expands to `.pa-table--bordered`, yielding `.pa-table--bordered:not(.pa-table--bordered--responsive)`. No one authors this class; it exists only inside a :not() guard. Listed here so the axis-1 block-modifier reverse-check accounts for it without inventing a phantom feature (fixing the SCSS is out of scope for this fidelity slice).

deferred.//: Per-CELL / data-driven element classes of the pa-table block — not container markup, and the harness slot carries only plain text so they can't be exercised here. Acknowledged out-of-scope (prose). item-title/item-desc = the two-line cell (name + spec stacked in one <td>, snippets/tables.html L138-166). checkbox-col/row--selected = selectable rows (leading checkbox column + selected-row tint, snippets/tables.html L176-218). All are native children the consumer writes inside <td>/<tr>, styled by core; keen's table/1 emits checkbox-col/row--selected on its data-driven path (verified in table_test.exs), svelte via hand-authored cells.
deferred.pa-table__item-title: two-line cell: primary item name (native <span> inside <td>)
